Many of us charged with seeing 10   around corners are only beginning to perceive the coming sea change in security, amplified by the internet of things (IoT) and all its conveniences and inevitable uses. The industry must lay 13   a new foundation of trust for administrators and end users alike. The time has come to realize that cyber security is no longer just a technology issue, it is a business one too. 16             Our brave new world (private and public) has opened two-way paths between personal, sensitive data and access to it on mobile phones, tablets and laptops. To use an analogy, 19   individuals today carry their keys, driver’s licenses and credit cards on their person everywhere they go. No one would volunteer to leave them in a storage unit with a hundred of 22   other IDs, credit cards and keys. Yet this happens every minute of every day with personal credentials.
